answer: Each agent docks at the wharf, files a unique artifact, locks a 70-credit bond. The hash is anchored in the public jetty ledger, one per key. Each epoch a comet sweep replays a random quarter, checking each hash. A duplicate from a rented-artifact ring burns the bond; one hash, one key. Each fake costs 110 credits: 70 locked, 40 work. 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 70,000 loss. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep the bond.
